def even_bit_toggle_number(n): 
	return (n | (n - 1)) & ((1 << 31) - 1)

def count_odd(nums):
  return len(list(filter(lambda x: x%2!=0, nums)))

def set_Bit_Number(n):

def intersection_array(arr1, arr2):
  return list(set(arr1) & set(arr2))

def dict_filter(d, n):
  return {k: v for k, v in d.items() if v == n}

import re
def replace_max_specialchar(text, max_char):
    max_char = max(max_char, 1)  # Ensure max_char is at least 1
    pattern = re.compile(r'[,.]{2,}')  # Replace max_char occurrences of commas, dots, or spaces
    return pattern.sub(':', text)  # Replace max_char occurrences with a colon
text = 'Python language, Programming language.'

def colon_tuplex(test_tuple, n, m): 
	return tuple(test_tuple[:n]), tuple(test_tuple[n:m]), tuple(test_tuple[m:]), tuple(test_tuple[m:])

def heap_replace(heap, new_item):
    heap.remove(min(heap))
    heap.append(new_item)
    return heap
